name: jikan to no tatakai no josei tachi
source:
A kinetic visual novel with eroge and horror themes based on an idea by Manuel Peters. With AI graphics and script writing by Michael Kumpmann.

A woman wakes up in a strange room, surrounded by a Nazi and a bizarre, sadistic creature with a pig head. She later learns that she is apparently already dead, and lived 3 past lives. One as a magician and part of the Vril Society. One as a runaway in Tokio and one as the commander of a secret space fleet in Saturn Orbit called Nachtwaffen. This fleet got destroyed by a weird incident which is connected to an ancient US Battleship from the second world war, called USS Eldridge, and experiments on an US military facility in the town of montauk. During this incident, a demonic entity looking like a flaming swine appeared on the fleet and haunted their crew.  

They also discover that, to stop the incidents unfolding, they need a very specific old IBM computer from the past.
translation:
這是一部融合情色與恐怖元素的單線視覺小說，創意來自曼努埃爾．彼得斯，採用AI生成的畫面，由麥可．庫普曼編劇。

一名女子在陌生房間裡醒來，身旁是一個納粹分子，還有一頭模樣詭異、以折磨他人為樂的豬頭怪物。她後來得知，自己似乎早已死去，而且有過三段前世。她曾是維力協會的魔法師，是流落東京的逃家人，也曾擔任駐紮在土星軌道的秘密太空艦隊「夜之兵器」的指揮官。艦隊毀於一樁怪事，此事牽涉二戰時期的美國海軍「埃爾德里奇」號軍艦，以及蒙托克鎮一處美軍設施裡的實驗。事發時，一個形似火焰野豬的惡魔現身艦隊，糾纏著艦上人員。

他們還發現，要阻止事態繼續發展，必須從過去找到某一款特定的IBM老式電腦。
